title: IELTS Practice Question Bank — Generated Content

reading.description: Each test contains 3 passages (test001-test013 have 3, test014 has 1). Each passage PDF includes the full reading text and 13 questions with answer blanks. answers.json per test contains the answer key.

writing.description: Each test contains Task 1 (chart/graph/diagram with prompt) and Task 2 (essay prompt). All 40 Task 1 PDFs include embedded chart images generated at 200dpi.

charts.description: All charts follow strict color contrast rules: 7-step blue gradient palette (#DCE9F7→#2E77C0), adaptive text colors based on luminance, #0D1F5C badges/borders, #555555 arrows

maps_description: Grid-based planning maps: no overlapping elements, scale bar, compass, legend, matching before/after layouts
